request: Analyze GSE239729 for PMID 38110408 (Cdo1-Camkk2-AMPK axis confers the protective effects of exercise against NAFLD in mice.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq, mouse liver (DA.p1: GSE239729 holds the RNA-seq of Fig. 3a,b,f and Supp. Fig. 2o)
final.primary_estimand: Paper's RNA-seq estimand: hepatocyte Cdo1 knockout (Cdo1-LKO) vs WT (Cdo1 flox/flox) liver transcriptome in HFD-fed mice WITHOUT exercise (S2.3.p1, FIG3 a, S4.19.p1). The requested estimand (exercise effect) is not part of the sequenced design.
final.sample_inclusion: n = 3 WT + 3 Cdo1-LKO, HFD-fed, sedentary (FIG3 a: 'HFD-fed mice without exercise', n = 3 mice per group)
planned_contrasts: Cdo1-LKO vs WT, HFD sedentary (FIG3 a; paper: 630 up / 672 down = 1302 DEGs at p < 0.05)
final.exercise_contrasts_in_paper: Exercise effects (WT/LKO x sedentary/exercise, Fig. 2d design, n = 6) are measured only by RT-qPCR, western blot, mitoDNA and histology (Fig. 1b, 3c-e); none were sequenced.
final.paper_method: DESeq2 1.20.0 on Hisat2-aligned reads (S4.19.p1); two-sided Wald test

paper_threshold.source_locator: FIG3 a ('p < 0.05'; 'Two-sided Wald tests without adjustment')

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: DA.p1 ties GSE239729 to Fig. 3a/b/f and Supp. Fig. 2o. S4.19.p1: 'Total RNA was obtained from the liver of HFD-fed control mice and Cdo1LKO mice'; FIG3 a: LKO vs WT 'in the livers of HFD-fed mice without exercise', n = 3/group, p < 0.05, unadjusted two-sided Wald. Exercise contrasts (S2.1, S2.2, S2.3 Fig. 3c) use qPCR/WB, not RNA-seq.

checks: GEO series title equals the paper title
series overall design: liver of HFD-fed control and Cdo1LKO mice
6 GSMs (3 WT, 3 Cdo1 liver KO) match FIG3 a n = 3 per group
contact institute Shanghai University of Sport matches the paper

ownership.reasoning: Single processed file GSE239729_Processed_date_files.txt.gz is the only matrix; it holds 6 sample columns for the 6 GSMs.

alignment.reasoning: The deposited matrix columns (A,B,C,A1,B1,C1) have no key in the GEO metadata, so the prep script prep_rename_columns.py renames them to GSM ids. Genotype group membership is evidence-based, not positional: Cdo1 (ENSMUSG00000033022) FPKM is 822-1072 in A/B/C and 243-272 in A1/B1/C1 (the hepatocyte KO), and log2 correlations cluster A/B/C vs A1/B1/C1. Within each genotype the replicate order (A->1, B->2, C->3) is an assumption; it does not affect any decision here because no comparison is executed and none would use within-group identity.

candidates.reason_rejected: the missing column key does not bear on the stop: the whole sample set lacks an exercise arm, which the metadata and the paper state independently of column identity

matrix.reasoning: Values are non-integer (integer fraction 0.65, mostly zeros), column sums 384k-524k (not equal library sizes), data_processing: 'FPKM of each gene was calculated based on the length of the gene and reads count'. The paper's DESeq2 input (raw counts) is not deposited as a separate file. Type is unambiguous; recorded for completeness.

design.stop_reason: No exercise contrast: all 6 deposited samples are HFD-fed sedentary mice (metadata treatment constant 'HFD feeding 12 weeks'; FIG3 a 'without exercise'), differing only by genotype (3 WT vs 3 Cdo1-LKO). The exercise effect the request asks for cannot be identified from this series; the paper measured exercise effects only by RT-qPCR/western blot. The genotype contrast (LKO vs WT) is a knockout effect, not an exercise effect, and is not run as a substitute.
design.reasoning: Grouping columns: only characteristics_ch1.1.genotype varies (WT 3, Cdo1 liver KO 3). No exercise/training/sedentary factor in metadata, titles, or series design. Paper S4.19.p1 and FIG3 a confirm the RNA-seq cohort is sedentary HFD WT vs LKO.

candidates.reason_rejected: answers the Cdo1 knockout question, not how exercise affects gene expression; running it would substitute a different estimand
no exercised samples exist in the series

discrepancies.data: only FPKM deposited (data_processing mentions counts, but the single supplementary file holds FPKM)
GEO data_processing says bowtie v0.12.2 to mm8 (appears to be template text; extract protocol also mentions 'Retinas')

discrepancies.paper: exercise intervention is the paper's central factor (Fig. 2d)
